requirements: Resize or pad the layout by the keyboard inset so the focused field and its error stay visible;Choose the keyboard type for each field, such as number, email, phone or URL;Set the Enter key action, such as Next to move fields or Done or Search to submit;Mark fields with content types so the OS can offer autofill and one-time codes;Let users dismiss the keyboard by scrolling or tapping outside without losing input;Test with hardware keyboards, split keyboards and large text
done_when: The focused field is never hidden behind the keyboard;Each field opens the right keyboard type;Pressing Next moves through the form in order and the last action submits

name: Back and up navigation
explanation: Making the system back gesture, the back button and the in-app back arrow move through the app's screens in the order people expect.
synonyms: predictive back;system back gesture;up button;back stack;onbackpressedcallback;swipe back gesture
triggers: back button goes to wrong screen;back gesture closes the app;swipe from edge to go back;intercept back press;back arrow in header
requirements: Make back return to the previous screen and exit the app only from the start screen;Make the in-app up arrow never leave the app, even after opening it from a deep link;Build a synthetic back stack for deep links so back leads to the parent screen;Let back first close sheets, dialogs, drawers and search before leaving the screen;Use the platform back callbacks so the predictive back preview works;Keep the iOS edge swipe back working on pushed screens
done_when: Back follows the path the user took and exits only from the start screen;Opening a deep link and pressing back goes to the parent screen;Back with a sheet open closes the sheet first;The predictive back preview shows the screen it will go to

name: Launch screen
explanation: The screen shown for a moment while a mobile app starts, built with the platform launch screen setup so it appears instantly and moves smoothly into the first real screen.
synonyms: splash screen;launch screen storyboard;splashscreen api;launch image
triggers: logo when app opens;loading screen at startup;app opening screen;screen while app loads
requirements: Use the platform launch screen API or launch storyboard, not an extra screen added before the first one;Keep it simple: background color and icon, no text that needs translating;Match the first screen and dark mode so there is no flash or jump;Do not hold it for long loads, show the first screen with a loading state instead;Do not use it for ads or branding pauses;Test cold start on old devices
done_when: The launch screen appears immediately when the app is tapped;There is no blank or white flash between launch and the first screen;It looks right in light and dark mode

name: App startup time
explanation: Measuring and shortening how long a mobile app takes to show its first usable screen after it is opened from cold, warm or hot start.
synonyms: cold start;warm start;time to initial display;time to full display;launch time;baseline profiles
triggers: app takes long to open;slow app launch;speed up opening the app;app stuck on logo
requirements: Measure cold, warm and hot starts on real low-end devices with release builds;Report when the app is fully drawn so full startup time can be tracked;Delay SDK and library setup that the first screen does not need;Keep disk, network and heavy work off the main thread during launch;Use startup profiles or ahead-of-time compilation where the platform offers them;Watch launch metrics from the field and alert on regressions
done_when: Cold start time on a low-end test device meets the agreed budget;Field data shows cold starts under 5 seconds, the Android vitals excessive threshold;A launch benchmark runs in CI and fails on regressions

name: Smooth scrolling and frame rate
explanation: Keeping lists and animations smooth by doing each frame's work within the time the display allows, so frames are not dropped and scrolling does not stutter.
synonyms: jank;dropped frames;frozen frames;hitches;slow rendering;frame budget
triggers: list stutters when scrolling;laggy scrolling;animation is choppy;app feels sluggish;scroll performance
requirements: Keep work per frame under the frame budget, about 16ms at 60Hz and less on higher refresh screens;Recycle list rows, give them stable IDs and update only changed items;Decode and resize images off the main thread to the size shown;Avoid deep or nested layouts and repeated measure passes in rows;Profile release builds on low-end devices with the platform frame tools;Track slow and frozen frame rates from real users
done_when: Scrolling a long list on a low-end device shows no visible stutter;Frame profiling shows few frames over budget;Field data shows slow and frozen frame rates within target

name: App hangs and ANRs
explanation: Stopping a mobile app from freezing, which on Android shows an Application Not Responding dialog, by keeping slow disk, network and heavy computing off the main thread.
synonyms: anr;application not responding;app hang;main thread blocking;watchdog termination
triggers: app freezes;app not responding dialog;app stops responding to taps;ui locks up;screen frozen
requirements: Never do network, database or large file work on the main thread;Use strict-mode checks in debug builds to catch main-thread disk and network use;Avoid locks the main thread waits on while a background thread holds them;Keep broadcast receivers and lifecycle callbacks short;Collect hang and ANR reports with stack traces from the field;Fix the most common hang stacks first and track the ANR rate per release
done_when: Strict-mode checks in debug builds report no main-thread disk or network access;The user-perceived ANR rate is below the store's bad behavior threshold;Hang reports show no recurring main-thread blocking

name: Crash symbolication
explanation: Saving and uploading the debug symbol and mapping files for every build so that crash reports show readable function names, files and line numbers.
synonyms: dsym upload;proguard mapping;r8 mapping file;deobfuscation;native debug symbols;retrace
triggers: crash report unreadable;stack trace shows random letters;obfuscated crash logs;missing symbols in crash
requirements: Archive dSYM files for every iOS build you ship, including CI and store builds;Upload the R8 or ProGuard mapping file for every Android release to the store and crash tool;Upload native debug symbols for apps with C or C++ code;Match symbols to builds by build UUID or version code, never by guess;Automate the upload in the release pipeline and fail if it is missing;Keep symbols for as long as old versions are in use
done_when: A test crash from a release build shows readable function names and line numbers;Every released build has its symbols and mapping in the crash tool;The pipeline fails when a symbol upload fails

name: App icons (adaptive and themed)
explanation: Making the icon shown on the home screen, in settings and in the store, in every size and style the platforms need, such as Android adaptive and themed icons and iOS dark and tinted icons.
synonyms: adaptive icon;themed icon;launcher icon;app icon set;monochrome icon;tinted icon
triggers: icon for my app;home screen icon;icon looks cut off;icon for dark mode;app store icon
requirements: Give Android a foreground and background layer at 108dp with the logo inside the central safe zone;Add a monochrome layer so the icon follows the user's theme;Provide iOS default, dark and tinted variants from a 1024 by 1024 pixel source;Keep the main iOS icon square and opaque, the system adds the rounded corners;Supply the store listing icon in the size the store asks for;Check the icon at small sizes and against light and dark wallpapers

name: Network connectivity handling
explanation: Detecting when a phone goes offline, back online or onto a metered or low data connection, and changing what the app downloads and shows to match.
synonyms: connectivity monitoring;nwpathmonitor;connectivitymanager;metered network;low data mode
triggers: no internet message;detect when phone is offline;only download on wifi;app breaks without signal;retry when back online

done_when: Turning on airplane mode shows a clear offline state without crashes;Turning the network back on retries pending work;Large downloads wait for unmetered networks when that setting is on

name: On-device database
explanation: Storing structured app data in a local database on the phone, such as SQLite, Room, Core Data or SwiftData, including updating its structure on users' devices.
synonyms: sqlite;room database;core data;swiftdata;local database;mobile database migration
triggers: store data on the phone;save records locally;app database offline;update local database schema;app loses data after update
requirements: Run queries off the main thread;Write a tested migration for every schema version, since users skip versions;Never fall back to deleting the database unless the data is only a cache;Keep the schema history in source control and test migrations from each past version;Wrap related writes in a transaction;Encrypt the database if it holds sensitive data and store the key in the platform keystore
done_when: Upgrading from every previously released schema keeps all user data;No database query runs on the main thread;Migration tests run in CI

name: App data backup and device transfer
explanation: Choosing which app data is copied to the cloud backup or moved when the user sets up a new phone, and leaving out secrets, tokens and cached files.
synonyms: auto backup;icloud backup;device transfer;backup rules;dataextractionrules
triggers: keep app data on new phone;restore app after reinstall;exclude files from backup;user logged in after phone switch
requirements: Decide per file whether it should be backed up, transferred to a new device, or neither;Exclude tokens, keys and device-bound secrets, as keystore keys do not move to a new device;Exclude caches and files that can be downloaded again;Use backup rules for both cloud backup and device-to-device transfer;Handle restored data that is older than the server data;Test a backup and restore and a device transfer
done_when: After restore the app opens without errors and with the expected data;No auth tokens or secrets come back after a restore;Cached files are not in the backup

name: Managed app configuration (MDM)
explanation: Letting a company's device management system send settings and restrictions to an app on employees' phones, such as a server address or turning off copy and paste.
synonyms: app restrictions;managed configurations;appconfig;mobile device management;emm
triggers: company sets app settings remotely;configure app for employees;work profile app settings;enterprise deployment of mobile app
requirements: Declare every setting with its type, default and description in the platform schema;Read managed values on start and listen for changes while the app runs;Use safe defaults when a value is missing or invalid;Do not let users change settings that the admin has locked;Do not send secrets through managed configuration;Report status back to the admin where the platform supports it
done_when: Changing a value in the device management console changes the app without reinstalling;Invalid or missing values fall back to safe defaults;Locked settings cannot be changed by the user

name: Apps for children
explanation: Meeting app store and legal rules for apps made for children, which limit ads, data collection and third-party code and require a parent gate before purchases or links out.
